        <span id="hs_cos_wrapper_post_body" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_meta_field hs_cos_wrapper_type_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="meta_field" data-hs-cos-type="rich_text"><p>Did you know that <a href="https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbestechcouncil/2025/08/27/the-cost-of-poor-software-quality-and-how-ai-can-fix-it/" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><span>40% of organisations</span></a> report that poor software quality costs them over $1 million annually? This massive loss, driven by defects, vulnerabilities, and rising technical debt, has pushed more development teams to adopt automated code review tools to catch issues earlier and strengthen code quality.</p>
<!--more-->
<p>However, not every tool provides the same level of security, accuracy, or confidence—and with so many options available, it’s not always easy to find the right fit for your workflow.&nbsp;</p>
<p>In this article, we’ve selected the <strong>top 8 a</strong><strong>utomated code review tools</strong><strong> </strong>to help you catch issues faster, reduce technical debt, and build more reliable software.</p>
<p></p><div class="hs-cta-embed hs-cta-simple-placeholder hs-cta-embed-171760058798" style="max-width:100%; max-height:100%; width:700px;height:137.953125px; margin: 0 auto; display: block; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px" data-hubspot-wrapper-cta-id="171760058798" align="center"> 
 <a href="/hs/cta/wi/redirect?encryptedPayload=AVxigLLSkYB1RC6c56NTldqDRfBQ%2FGfOYqF%2BbOjdvOxSdfa0a57xjfCFQpghQN9pnwGMpIhhEOTdGIGy2B0Iv214N06tm8aVW3%2BuLgZvIvu9cnfgpfx5K%2F9%2F5B4afK60cUccpiej61cxALW0yJYasdbphFWw0otWeRVDn5%2FScuoriYvH%2FCc%3D&amp;webInteractiveContentId=171760058798&amp;portalId=46014728" target="_blank" rel="noopener" crossorigin="anonymous"> <img alt="Boost Your Coding with Zencoder" loading="lazy" src="https://no-cache.hubspot.com/cta/default/46014728/interactive-171760058798.png" style="height: 100%; width: 100%; object-fit: fill; margin: 0 auto; display: block; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px" onerror="this.style.display='none'" align="center"> </a> 
</div><p></p>

<p><strong>Codacy</strong> is an end-to-end security, code-review, and quality platform that enforces consistent standards across the entire SDLC, from IDE and AI-generated code to <a href="/blog/ci-cd-pipelines-with-ai" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><span>CI/CD</span></a> and production. <h3>Key Features:</h3>
<p>1️⃣<strong> Automated PR analysis</strong> – Delivers instant, rule-based code review on every <a href="/glossary/pull-request" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><span>pull request</span></a> to enforce quality and catch issues early.</p>
<p>2️⃣<strong> Static security scanning </strong>– Detects vulnerabilities, secrets, and insecure patterns across 40+ languages using industry-grade <a href="/glossary/code-analysis" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><span>analysis</span></a>.</p>
<p>3️⃣ <strong>AI guardrails for code generation </strong>– Evaluates and auto-fixes AI-generated code in real time to prevent security and quality regressions.</p>
<p>4️⃣ <strong>Quality metrics and coverage tracking </strong>– Monitors duplication, complexity, style, and test coverage to maintain consistent engineering standards.</p>
<h3>Pros and Cons:</h3>
<p>🟢 <strong>Pros:</strong></p>

</ul>
